question: When a person's hair seems to turn white in a few days, what is the likeliest explanation?
options: Stress bleaching pigment inside the hairs
Dark hairs falling out, sparing grey ones
Air bubbles forming inside the hair shafts
answer: Dark hairs falling out. A hair shaft is dead, so pigment already in it cannot be withdrawn. In a sudden bout of alopecia areata, an immune attack on follicles, pigmented hairs are mostly shed and white ones spared. A partly grey head then turns white in days, because only the grey hairs are left.
move: When a crowd changes colour overnight, ask who left.
ask: When something seems to change overnight in a crowd, do I ask who left?
trap: Picturing fright draining the colour from hairs already grown.
source: Nahm, Navarini & Kelly, Int J Trichology, 2013
reference: Nahm, Navarini & Kelly, Canities subita: a reappraisal of evidence based on 196 case reports published in the medical literature, International Journal of Trichology, 2013
